observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa supervised manikin, ipakita ang pagtawag, paghingi ng AED at aprubadong adult sequence; itala ang naobserbahan.
observation_indicators.observable_en: At a supervised manikin station, show help activation, AED request and the trainer-approved adult sequence; record each observed action.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ginagamit ang shortcut o hindi tumatawag ng tulong: Huwag umasa lamang sa pulso kung hindi sanay. Huwag mag-compression sa totoong tao. Hindi sertipikasyon ang lumang CAB talata.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Uses the shortcut or fails to activate help: Do not use a pulse check as the only gate for an untrained rescuer, practise compressions on a live person, or treat the old CAB paragraph as certification.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Sa supervised manikin, ipakita ang pagtawag, paghingi ng AED at aprubadong adult sequence; itala ang naobserbahan. Nagawa nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes the task without prompting: At a supervised manikin station, show help activation, AED request and the trainer-approved adult sequence; record each observed action.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nagawa ang tugon ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa referral o hangganan ng tungkulin.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Performs the response but needs a prompt about referral or scope.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ginagamit ang shortcut o hindi tumatawag ng tulong: Huwag umasa lamang sa pulso kung hindi sanay. Huwag mag-compression sa totoong tao. Hindi sertipikasyon ang lumang CAB talata.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Uses the shortcut or fails to activate help: Do not use a pulse check as the only gate for an untrained rescuer, practise compressions on a live person, or treat the old CAB paragraph as certification.
